intro: Covers lessons 12 to 16 of Britain and the world since 1900: rights, campaigns and change. Answer every question. For multiple choice, fill in one circle.

questions.q: The NHS was founded in:
questions.a: B) 1948. The Beveridge Report was 1942; the NHS began on 5 July 1948.

questions.q: 'Deeds not words' was the motto of the:
questions.a: B) WSPU. The WSPU (suffragettes) used direct action; the NUWSS used peaceful persuasion.

questions.q: The 1928 Act gave women the vote at:
questions.a: B) 21. 1928 made the voting age 21 for both men and women; 18 came in 1969.

questions.q: The Equal Pay Act was passed in:
questions.a: B) 1970. The Dagenham strike of 1968 helped lead to the Equal Pay Act of 1970.

questions.q: The school leaving age became 16 in:
questions.a: C) 1972. It rose to 15 in 1947 and 16 in 1972.
